name: Mii
source:
Mii is the youngest sister. She has light purple hair which is often tied in double buns on her head, except when she cosplays "Magical Girl Mii"; she then wears it in twintails. Mii goes to the same school as [url=/c12302]Mai[/url]. Mii is the most energetic, perverted and naive of the three. She goes around asking [url=/c12299]Chris[/url] to play with her almost anytime she sees him and loves to cosplay as a magical girl, "Magical Girl Mii", trying to help others out around town, though the results often vary.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Mii]Wikipedia[/url].]
